raw_text:
- Top priority. Goal: junior software developer role within about six months. Target ₹6–8 LPA, possibly ₹9–10 LPA with competing offers
- Strategy: Instahyre, LinkedIn, Wellfound, mid-size funded startups. Frames himself as a Node.js backend developer, not "MERN stack"
- Instabooking (solo-built, multi-tenancy, payments, RBAC) is the resume centerpiece. The resume was found to undersell his work and has been fixed
- Sent roughly 10-20 untargeted applications, got zero replies, stopped applying. Search has stalled since
- Unhappy with his PPO pay compared to campus-placed peers; understands it reflects the startup's constraints and his negotiating position, not his skill
- System design gap is about terminology and articulation, not capability
- Main gap is interview-readiness, not raw knowledge. Known risk: losing momentum after bursts of effort
- Stack: Node.js, Express, MongoDB. DSA at foundational level (working on hashing and hash maps). n8n job-application pipeline
- Learns best by explaining concepts in his own words first, then getting corrections
